metadata.title: Monochrome Profile Portrait with Header Bar

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome profile portrait featuring a subject with eyes closed and head tilted back, framed by a solid dark header bar containing wide-tracked serif typography.
triggerTerms: monochrome profile portrait with header bar
90s style black and white album cover
wide tracked serif text on dark banner
excludeWhen: the subject needs to look at the camera
a busy or textured background is preferred

recipe.visualDefinition: A black and white studio photograph of a man in profile, wearing a dark turtleneck, with his head tilted upward and eyes closed in a contemplative or ecstatic expression. The composition is topped by a solid dark horizontal bar that spans the full width, housing white serif text with extreme letter spacing.
coreVisualRelationships: The dark turtleneck merges with the bottom frame, creating a solid base.
The horizontal header bar provides a geometric counterpoint to the organic curves of the face and hair.
The subject's upward gaze directs the viewer's eye toward the top-left corner.
High-contrast lighting emphasizes the texture of the hair and the contours of the jawline.
coreInvariants: Solid horizontal header bar at the top edge

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered horizontally, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame, scaled to a medium close-up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark header bar at the top acts as the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the dark base of the turtleneck, follows the line of the neck and jaw upward, and rests on the typography in the header.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample neutral grey space surrounds the subject's head, isolating the profile.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the turtleneck and header bar
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the typography and highlights
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between the subject's skin highlights and the dark clothing.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Inclusion of a small decorative icon (like a cross) as a separator between words

composition.relationshipToImage: Contained within a separate graphic element

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with varying tracking or a small symbolic glyph for separation.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the classic, sharp serif look with high legibility at wide tracking.
Offers the necessary stroke contrast and elegant terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a monochrome studio portrait of a person in profile, head tilted back, eyes closed, wearing a black turtleneck against a solid grey background. Leave the top 10% of the frame empty for a graphic overlay.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a solid black horizontal bar across the top edge. Center white, all-caps serif text within this bar using extremely wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the text in the header bar all-caps with wide tracking?
Is the subject in a clear profile view with head tilted up?
Does the black turtleneck blend into the bottom of the frame?

mustRedesign: The specific name and title text
The exact facial features of the individual
postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast separation between jawline and background.
Ensure the header bar is perfectly horizontal and spans the full width.
Verify that the text is centered vertically within the header bar.
Confirm the monochrome palette has no color cast.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Profile + Upward Tilt + Black Turtleneck + Wide-Tracked Serif Header
